expansion_name: Flash Point: Fire Rescue - Extreme Danger
prerequisite_rule: Needs the Flash Point: Fire Rescue base game. Works standalone with the base game; combines with 2nd Story for four extra building layouts.
what_it_adds: Six building configurations, firefighter miniatures with coloured bases, explosive-object and hazmat/chemical-spill tokens, fire-proof doors, a fire engine platform and an attic/basement extension board, in a box that holds all prior expansions.
what_it_fixes: Older expansions were separate silos; its tokens and attic/basement board can be mixed into earlier maps for much more variety.
verdict_reason: The one expansion that mixes with earlier maps and is also the storage box for the rest; iSlaytheDragon rated it 9.5 and called it the best so far, while advising newcomers to ease in via smaller packs.
notes: Reviewer was supplied a review copy by the publisher. Amazon ASIN B00GDI4IQK listed on the publisher page now returns 404; no working ASIN verified.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the Flash Point: Fire Rescue base game.
what_it_adds: Two double-sided mounted half boards (two-storey house and small hotel), plus ladders, windows, stairs, weak walls, an explosion marker and action tokens.
what_it_fixes: Adds vertical play and new access routes so the single-floor base house stops feeling repetitive.
verdict_reason: Cheapest way to add a second floor and ladders; iSlaytheDragon rated it 9 and called it worth the upgrade, noting action-point costs need a self-made reference sheet.
notes: Reviewer was supplied a review copy by the publisher. Publisher page lists 2018 (reprint); reviewed Feb 2014, so first release is earlier. Amazon ASIN B009SACAS8 listed on the publisher page now returns 404; no working ASIN verified.

expansion_name: Flash Point: Fire Rescue - Dangerous Waters
prerequisite_rule: Needs the Flash Point: Fire Rescue base game.
what_it_adds: Two double-sided half boards: a commercial ship (engine room, cabins, steel walls) and a 3x16 submarine with medical bays, plus hull walls, bulkheads, fire-proof doors and must-protect machinery.
what_it_fixes: Gives very different layouts, especially the long submarine, when the house maps feel stale.
verdict_reason: Cheap and self-contained, with a submarine map reviewers call unique; iSlaytheDragon rated it 9, though it does not mix with other expansions.
notes: Reviewer was supplied a review copy by the publisher.

expansion_name: Flash Point: Fire Rescue - Urban Structures
prerequisite_rule: Needs the Flash Point: Fire Rescue base game.
what_it_adds: Two new buildings (high-rise office and duplex), a Structural Engineer specialist, new rules, scenarios and variants.
what_it_fixes: Provides fresh maps and a wall-repairing role that changes how a team splits up work.
verdict_reason: Low-cost extra maps plus a useful Structural Engineer role; iSlaytheDragon rated it 8.5 and called it worth picking up, with minor ladder-rule ambiguity.
notes: Reviewer was supplied a review copy by the publisher.

expansion_name: Flash Point: Fire Rescue - Tragic Events
prerequisite_rule: Needs the Flash Point: Fire Rescue base game; it replaces the Hot Spot mechanic of the experienced rules.
what_it_adds: Fire deck and event deck (42 events, 8 special points of interest), three specialists with miniatures and a revised Structural Engineer.
what_it_fixes: Replaces dice-driven Hot Spots with a fire deck that escalates over the game and adds story events.
verdict_reason: Recommended by Unboxed but it makes the game fiddlier and roughly 50% longer, so it suits veterans who want more difficulty rather than first-time expansion buyers.
notes: Publisher page lists 2-5 players and 15-30 min; the reviewer lists 2-6 players at 45 min, so 2-6 used to match the base game. Reviewer notes it was originally not planned for general retail.

expansion_name: Flash Point: Fire Rescue - Honor & Duty
requires_also: Extreme Danger or 2nd Story (attic/basement board only)
prerequisite_rule: Needs the Flash Point: Fire Rescue base game; the attic/basement board also needs Extreme Danger or 2nd Story.
what_it_adds: A double-sided board with an airplane fire on one side and a subway station disaster on the other, plus new markers and instructions.
what_it_fixes: Adds two unusual disaster scenarios to break up repeated house and building maps.
verdict_reason: Only two extra maps and its attic/basement board needs another expansion; BGG users rate it about 7.6, below the other expansions, so buy it last.
notes: No independent written review located; verdict based on BGG community rating (7.6, 687 ratings) and publisher contents.
